dashboard_id.description: Only the series of the insights on this dashboard, by numeric id.

date_from.description: Earliest bucket start in the range. A relative date such as `-7d` or `-24h`, or an ISO 8601 date.

date_to.description: Latest bucket start in the range. A relative date or an ISO 8601 date. Defaults to now.

group_by.description:
`series` returns one row per series in `series`. `insight` returns one row per insight in `insights`.

* `series` - Series
* `insight` - Insight

insight_id.description: Only the series of this insight, by numeric id.

interval.description:
Only series with this interval.

* `hour` - Hour
* `day` - Day
* `week` - Week
* `month` - Month

only_flagged.description: Only series, or insights, with at least one flagged bucket in the range. Set false to also list quiet ones.
